library(lab06)

## Brute force search

*How much time does it take to run the algorithm for n = 16 objects?*

```{r}
knapsack_objects <- random_numbers_for_knapsack()

# Run bench::mark() once for every combination of the parameters
runs <- bench::press(
  n = c(8, 12, 16, 20),
  W = 3500,
  {
    bench::mark(brute_force_knapsack(x = knapsack_objects[1:n, ], W = W),
                filter_gc = FALSE)
  },
  .quiet = TRUE
)

# Show the results in a table
runs[, c("n", "W", "min", "median", "itr/sec", "mem_alloc")]
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
cat("It takes about", format(runs$median[runs$n == 16]), "(median)")
```

## Greedy heuristic

*How much time does it take to run the algorithm for n = 1,000,000 objects?*

```{r}
knapsack_objects_large <- suppressWarnings(random_numbers_for_knapsack(n = 1e6))

res_greed <- bench::mark(greedy_knapsack(x = knapsack_objects_large, W = 3500),
                         filter_gc = FALSE)

res_greed[, c("min", "median", "itr/sec", "mem_alloc")]
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
cat("It takes about", format(res_greed$median), "(median)")
```
